svg.title: Packaging operator — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as packaging operator, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: An open carton sits beneath a tape-sealing roll and its support arm. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, an oval face.
